title: oakgrovetech
description:
The company specializes in multi-domain training, unmanned systems & robotics, cyber/space operations, learning/courseware development, staff augmentation, intelligence analysis, and operates a Test & Training Center near Fort Bragg/Hoffman, NC. It primarily serves DoD clients including USASOC and 1st Special Forces Command.

Corporate email archive of CEO and executive management (12 PST files, 35.14 GB) — forwarded credentials, NDAs, negotiations with the DoD/FBI and other companies.
Deltek GCS payroll module: banking details of all vendors and contractors.
Accounting system backup.
Company QuickBooks files — OGT financial database: bank accounts, employee SSNs, administrator password.
Contracts, personal data (PII), SSNs and much more.
